summary: LandBridge Company LLC filed a Form 8-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing that subsidiary DBR Land Holdings LLC intends to offer $100 million in additional 6.250% senior notes due 2030 via Rule 144A/Reg S private placement, adding to $500 million of existing notes issued under a November 25, 2025 indenture. The new notes carry identical terms except issue date and price, and trade as one series. Net proceeds repay revolver borrowings. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; watch pricing, demand and leverage.
